title: fix(configure): update lifecycle state
body:
## Description

This fixes the lifecycle of `connectConfigure`.

## Changes

- `getConfiguration` returns a state computed with `SearchParameters`
- `refine` relies on `mergeSearchParameters` directly instead of passing a virtual widget to `enhanceConfiguration`
- `removeSearchParameters` was removed from the widget scope to not pollute it
- `connectConfigure` tests now also check that search parameters are resolved correctly (e.g. with facets as an array)
